description: This file defines the layout component for a global sidebar navigation in a Next.js application. It manages the sidebar's expand/collapse state, renders navigation links with icons, and maintains user preferences via localStorage.

methods.name: GlobalSidebarLayout
methods.description: React functional component that renders a sidebar layout with navigation links and toggle functionality, with state persistence.
